Executive Assistant to the CEO Job at Sterling Gate Services Limited




        
    

        
        Sterling Gate Services Ltd is an indigenous consulting firm established in 2017, providing structured and tailored support to organisations across multiple sectors. We partner with companies strengthening HR functions, recruiting top talent, and managing facilities, office supplies, catering, and general support services, aligned with business objectives and professional best practices. Supporting People, Places & Processes

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Executive Assistant to the CEO

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (Hybrid)

The Role
     

            
    




	We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive and resourceful Executive Assistant to support the CEO.
	This is more than a diary-management role. We need someone who can anticipate the CEO’s needs, keep things moving, coordinate across teams and ensure important actions are followed through.


What you’ll be doing


	Manage the CEO’s calendar, meetings, appointments and schedules.
	Coordinate meetings and ensure the CEO is properly briefed ahead of engagements.
	Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, briefs and other documents.
	Take and track meeting action points and follow up with responsible team members.
	Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders on behalf of the CEO.
	Support the CEO with research, information gathering and business correspondence.
	Draft and manage emails, letters, memos and other official communications.
	Help the CEO track strategic priorities, projects and deadlines.
	Organize travel, meetings, events and other engagements as required.
	Maintain confidential information and handle sensitive matters with discretion.
	Represent the CEO professionally in selected communications and engagements.
	Provide general administrative and operational support to the CEO.
	Handle special projects and other assignments delegated by the CEO.


What we’re looking for


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related field.
	3–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Executive Officer or similar role.
	Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
	Strong written and verbal communication skills.
	Excellent Microsoft Office/Google Workspace skills.
	Strong follow-up and coordination abilities.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
	High level of discretion and confidentiality.
	Strong attention to detail.
	Ability to work independently, anticipate needs and take initiative.
	Professional, mature and confident when dealing with senior executives and external stakeholders.
	Experience in a startup, technology or fast-paced environment is an advantage.


The kind of person we need:


	We need someone who doesn't have to be chased before getting things done.
	You should be proactive, organized, discreet, sharp and dependable, with the ability to understand what the CEO needs and help make it happen.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Executive Assistant to the CEO” as the subject of the email.

  "description": "Leen Premium Limited is a dynamic and quality-driven company committed to delivering excellence in the production and distribution of premium bottled water and related products. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Sango-Ota, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Accountant will be responsible for managing the company&#39;s financial records, monitoring income and expenditure, preparing financial reports, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, and supporting management in making sound financial decisions.
	The Accountant must maintain proper financial controls and ensure that all financial transactions are properly documented and accounted for.


Key Responsibilities
Financial Record Keeping:


	Record and maintain accurate daily financial transactions.
	Maintain proper records of income, expenses, purchases, sales, receipts and payments.
	Reconcile cash, bank and other financial accounts regularly.
	Ensure that all financial documents are properly filed and easily accessible.
	Monitor and maintain accurate records of company assets and liabilities.


Accounts Payable and Receivable:


	Prepare and process payments to suppliers and service providers.
	Monitor outstanding customer balances and follow up on receivables.
	Prepare invoices, receipts and payment documentation.
	Maintain accurate supplier and customer account records.
	Ensure payments are properly authorized before processing.


Payroll and Staff Records:


	Prepare monthly payroll and salary schedules.
	Ensure accurate calculation of salaries, deductions, allowances and other benefits.
	Maintain records of staff advances, loans and deductions.
	Work with HR to ensure payroll information is accurate and up to date.


Cash and Bank Management:


	Monitor daily cash inflows and outflows.
	Prepare bank reconciliation statements.
	Monitor company bank balances and cash position.
	Ensure proper documentation and authorization of withdrawals and payments.
	Report unusual or unauthorized financial transactions to management.


Financial Reporting:


	Prepare daily, weekly and monthly financial reports.
	Prepare income and expenditure statements.
	Provide management with financial information required for decision-making.
	Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets.
	Highlight significant variances and financial risks to management.


Tax and Statutory Compliance:


	Assist in preparing and maintaining records required for tax and statutory obligations.
	Ensure proper documentation for PAYE, pension, NSITF, NHF, VAT and other applicable statutory obligations.
	Liaise with relevant consultants, auditors and government agencies when required.
	Keep abreast of changes in applicable accounting and tax requirements.


Inventory and Cost Control:


	Work closely with the Store and Production departments to monitor stock movement.
	Reconcile stock records with accounting records.
	Monitor raw material, packaging material and finished-product costs.
	Identify unusual stock losses, wastage or discrepancies and report them to management.
	Assist in determining production costs and profitability.


Audit and Internal Control:


	Maintain proper documentation for internal and external audits.
	Assist auditors by providing requested financial records and explanations.
	Ensure compliance with company financial policies and procedures.
	Identify weaknesses in financial controls and recommend improvements.
	Help prevent fraud, financial errors and unauthorized expenditures.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Accountant will be assessed based on:


	Accuracy and completeness of financial records.
	Timely preparation of financial reports.
	Accuracy of payroll and payment schedules.
	Timely bank and cash reconciliations.
	Proper monitoring of receivables and payables.
	Effective cost and expense control.
	Compliance with tax and statutory obligations.
	Accuracy of inventory and production cost records.
	Timely identification and reporting of financial discrepancies.
	Proper maintenance of accounting documents and records.


Required Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree / HND in Accounting, Finance, Banking &amp; Finance, or a related field.
	2&ndash;4 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in manufacturing, FMCG or a related industry.
	Professional accounting qualification or membership of a recognized accounting body is an added advantage.
	Good knowledge of bookkeeping and financial reporting.
	Experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Sage or similar software is an advantage.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.


Required Skills:


	Strong numerical and analytical skills.
	Attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good knowledge of accounting principles.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
	Integrity, confidentiality and accountability.
	Ability to identify financial discrepancies and irregularities.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Personal Attributes:
The successful candidate must be:


	Honest and trustworthy.
	Detail-oriented.
	Responsible and accountable.
	Disciplined and organized.
	Proactive in identifying financial issues.
	Confidential when handling company and employee financial information.
	Willing to work closely with management and other departments.


Working Relationship:
The Accountant will work closely with:


	Managing Director/General Manager
	HR/Admin Department
	Store Department
	Sales/Marketing Department
	Procurement/Supply Department
	External auditors, tax consultants and relevant government agencies


Salary
N140,000 - N200,000 per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: kristology001@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

Mechanical Engineer Job at Alpha Mead Group




        
    

        
        Alpha Mead Group is a Total Real Estate Solutions Company established to provide robust business support services to local and international Real Estate investors or owners with interests in Facilities Management, Real Estate Development and Advisory, Security Systems and Technologies, Training, Healthcare Management, and Real Estate Financing Services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Mechanical Engineer

Job Location: Kano

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage the operation, maintenance, and performance of mechanical systems and equipment within the facility.
	Develop and implement preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for mechanical assets.
	Supervise the maintenance of HVAC systems, chillers, pumps, cooling towers, plumbing systems, generators, fire-fighting systems, and other mechanical equipment.
	Conduct routine inspections, diagnose faults, and coordinate timely corrective actions.
	Monitor contractors and service providers to ensure compliance with SLAs, quality standards, and safety requirements.
	Maintain accurate records of equipment, maintenance activities, faults, repairs, and spare parts.
	Ensure compliance with HSE requirements, statutory regulations, and facility maintenance standards.
	Monitor energy and equipment performance and identify opportunities for improved efficiency and cost optimisation.
	Prepare maintenance reports and provide recommendations on equipment replacement, repairs, and improvements.
	Support the Facility Manager in ensuring the smooth and reliable operation of the mall.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
	5–8 years of relevant experience, preferably in facility management, commercial buildings, shopping malls, hospitality, manufacturing, or similar environments.
	Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chillers, pumps, plumbing, fire-fighting systems, and other mechanical building services.
	Experience in preventive and corrective maintenance and maintenance planning.
	Experience supervising technicians, contractors, and service providaers.
	Good knowledge of CMMS, maintenance documentation, and reporting.
	Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
	Professional certification or membership of a relevant engineering body will be an advantage.
	Candidates resident in Kano or willing to relocate to Kano will be preferred.

	Excellent written and verbal communication for presenting findings.

 Job Position: Credit Analyst

	The Credit Analyst will be responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of individuals, businesses or counterparties and support sound lending/investment decisions.
	The successful candidate will analyze financial statements, evaluate risk, and provide recommendations that balance growth with prudent risk management.


Key Responsibilities


	Analyze financial statements, cash flow, and credit history to assess borrower risk.
	Prepare credit memos and risk ratings for loan/credit committee review.
	Monitor existing portfolio accounts for covenant compliance and early warning signs.
	Build financial models to project repayment capacity and stress-test scenarios.
	Research industry trends, market conditions, and competitor positioning.
	Collaborate with relationship managers, underwriters, and legal/compliance teams.
	Ensure analysis complies with internal credit policy and regulatory requirements.
	Recommend credit limits, terms, and pricing based on risk assessment.


Qualifications


	First Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
	2-5 years of credit analysis, underwriting, or related financial experience.
	Strong skills in financial statement analysis and modeling (Excel required).
	Familiarity with credit risk tools/software and rating methodologies.
	Excellent written and verbal communication for presenting findings.
	Detail-oriented with strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
